core_obligations: Reduce to a single injective A-module by induction on the length of a finite injective complex and distinguished triangles (proof lines 378-385).
Compute the presheaf of Exts on principal opens and identify it with the tilde of Hom_A(H^{-n}(K), I) (proof lines 386-412).
proof_roadmap: The presheaf computation and conclusion (proof lines 386-412).
difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian ring A with X = Spec(A) and K, L in D(A) with K in D_Coh(A) and L of finite injective dimension, the lemma asserts RSheafHom_{O_X}(K~, L~) = the tilde of RHom_A(K, L) in D(O_X) (statement lines 365-376). The proof assumes L is given by a finite complex I^bullet of injective A-modules, and by induction on the length and compatibility with distinguished triangles reduces to L = I[0] with I injective (proof lines 378-385). In that case Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-internal-hom identifies the n-th cohomology sheaf of RSheafHom_{O_X}(K~, L~) as the sheaf associated to the presheaf D(f) -> Ext^n_{A_f}(K otimes_A A_f, I otimes_A A_f) (proof lines 386-395). Since A is Noetherian the localisation I otimes_A A_f is injective by Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-localization-injective-modules, so the Ext computes as Hom_{A_f}(H^{-n}(K otimes_A A_f), I otimes_A A_f) = Hom_{A_f}(H^{-n}(K) otimes_A A_f, I otimes_A A_f) = Hom_A(H^{-n}(K), I) otimes_A A_f, the last step because H^{-n}(K) is a finite A-module by Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-hom-from-finitely-presented (proof lines 396-410). This identifies both sides and the proof is done (proof lines 410-412). Reducing along triangles to a single injective and then computing the presheaf of Exts on a basis of principal opens is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
